cfg.enchantworks.server.title: Anvil & Enchantments (Server)
cfg.enchantworks.server.description: Server-owned anvil, enchantment registration, filtering, and balance settings. This page is unavailable while connected to a remote server without secure synchronization.
cfg.enchantworks.server.apply_notice: Balance and rule caches refresh when saved. Enchantment registration toggles and registry-level disabled entries require a full game or server restart.
cfg.enchantworks.anvil.remove_limit.tool: Remove the Too Expensive cap and prior-work penalty for matching items.
cfg.enchantworks.anvil.whitelist_mode.to: Enabled: only listed items are unlocked. Disabled: listed items keep vanilla limits and all others are unlocked.
cfg.enchantworks.anvil.item_list.tooltip: Items used by the anvil whitelist or blacklist mode.
cfg.enchantworks.anvil.item_list.syntax: Item filter syntax: item ID for one item, #tag for a tag, or @modid for every item from a mod. Example: minecraft:stick, #minecraft:logs, @create.
cfg.enchantworks.tax_free.enable.tooltip: Consume a fixed XP-point equivalent instead of raw levels, avoiding inflated costs at very high levels.
cfg.enchantworks.tax_free.level_base.too: At 30, a three-level cost always uses the XP required to go from level 30 to 27.
cfg.enchantworks.tax_free.cheap_renaming: Pure anvil renaming always costs one level.
cfg.enchantworks.enchantment.better_chan: Allow Channeling lightning in any weather; level II has the enhanced behavior.
cfg.enchantworks.enchantment.rules.synta: Combination rule syntax: target items ; enchantment IDs. Targets accept item IDs, #tags, and @modids; use comma-separated enchantments or * / ALL for every enchantment.
cfg.enchantworks.enchantment.whitelist.t: Force matching item/enchantment combinations to pass compatibility checks.
cfg.enchantworks.enchantment.blacklist.t: Strictly reject matching item/enchantment combinations and clear the anvil output.
cfg.enchantworks.enchantment.disabled.to: Enchantment IDs listed here cannot be applied by an anvil or enchanting table. Disabling this mod's own registrations requires restart.
cfg.enchantworks.enchantment.registry_to: Controls whether this enchantment is registered. A full restart is required.
cfg.enchantworks.values.smelter_chests.t: Let Smelter process items inside containers such as chests and shulker boxes.
Allow Fortune to affect drops processed by Smelter.
cfg.enchantworks.values.smelter_mobs.too: Automatically smelt applicable mob drops unless the attacker is sneaking.
cfg.enchantworks.values.smelter_exp.tool: Multiplier for experience awarded by Smelter recipes; 1.0 is the recipe's normal value.
cfg.enchantworks.values.smelter_multipli: First matching rule determines the output multiplier.
Output rule syntax: [number]x target. Targets accept item IDs, #tags, and @modids. Omitting the multiplier defaults to 2x; example: 3x minecraft:raw_iron.
cfg.enchantworks.values.leech_blacklist_: Leech Effects List Is a Blacklist
Enabled: listed effects cannot be stolen. Disabled: only listed effects can be stolen.
cfg.enchantworks.values.leech_effects.to: Status-effect IDs filtered by the selected list mode.
cfg.enchantworks.values.leech_trigger.to: Chance per eligible direct attack to trigger Leech, from 0.0 to 1.0.
Health restored as a fraction of damage dealt, multiplied by enchantment level.
cfg.enchantworks.values.leech_steal.tool: Chance to move one eligible beneficial effect from the target to the attacker.
cfg.enchantworks.values.omni_speed.toolt: Base speed boost relative to the current tool; block hardness may add further compensation.
cfg.enchantworks.values.omni_chance.tool: Chance in the third enchanting-table slot when its displayed level is at least 30, from 0.0 to 1.0.
cfg.enchantworks.values.force_drop.toolt: Exceptional blocks that forcibly drop themselves when mined with Omni-Tool.
cfg.enchantworks.values.force_drop.synta: Forced-drop syntax: block ID, #block_tag, or @modid. Unlisted blocks still obey their loot tables; forced drops suppress block XP for that break.
cfg.enchantworks.values.enlightenment.to: Each Enlightenment level increases experience generated from player kills and block breaking.
cfg.enchantworks.sixth_sense.title: Sixth Sense Display (Client)
cfg.enchantworks.sixth_sense.description: Local Sixth Sense scanning and outline preferences. They can be edited while connected to a remote server.
cfg.enchantworks.sixth_sense.range.toolt: Non-negative radius in blocks scanned while crouching with Sixth Sense. Very large values can be expensive.
cfg.enchantworks.sixth_sense.tick_rate.t: Positive interval between nearby-entity scans; 20 ticks is approximately one second.
cfg.enchantworks.sixth_sense.custom_mobs: Exact entity IDs that use the custom highlight color.
cfg.enchantworks.sixth_sense.color.toolt: RGB outline color used for this entity category while Sixth Sense highlighting is active.
enchantment.enchantworks.smelter.desc: When breaking blocks (including chests) or killing mobs, automatically smelts drops. Raw ores drop double. Does not work while sneaking.
enchantment.enchantworks.leech.desc: Chance to restore health or steal target's status effects on attack.
enchantment.enchantworks.sixth_sense.des: Detects and highlights nearby mobs in different colors while sneaking.
enchantment.enchantworks.enlightenment.d: Increases experience generated from kills and block breaking.
enchantment.enchantworks.omni_tool.desc: §aOmni Tool:§f Grants the enchanted tool the mining capabilities of §bPickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Hoe, Shears§f. When the enchantment table's third slot reaches level 30, appears with configured probability, default 10%. Base speed is compensated by current tool speed multiplier, with additional acceleration based on block hardness. Does not bypass blocks' own drop rules; only special blocks in the config list are forced to drop.
enchantment.enchantworks.channeling2.des: §6Enhanced Channeling II: §bCan summon lightning in any weather.
enchantment.enchantworks.infinity_bow.de: Shoots arrows without requiring them in inventory
enchantment.enchantworks.infinity_bucket: Provides infinite water source / void liquid absorption
